caption: The drawing depicts an antique oil lamp. The lamp has a clear, glass chimney at the top with scalloped edges and etched decorative patterns. Below the chimney is a brass burner mechanism with a small knob on the right side. The central section of the lamp, which appears to be the oil reservoir, is bulbous in shape and features a white surface adorned with oval and star-shaped red patterns. The lamp is supported by a slender, fluted column that is white or light gray in color, leading down to a square, tiered base that is also white or light gray. The background of the drawing is a plain cream or beige color. The overall composition is centered and the lamp is rendered in a realistic style.
title: Lamp
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
